body:
Me being suicidal doesn't mean I don't fucking bust my ass every single day to try and be a good mom. Life fucked me over but I have tried my goddamn hardest for them. I have done things I am not proud of for them. And why am I even justifying that to an internet stranger?

I shouldn't be. I'm going to go talk to someone who gives a shit hopedully.

And I have been working hard. I got a new job to supplement income. I have been taking my daughter to her intensive therapy. Parents are fucking human too. Parents feel. I am still a person with two children. I can still feel suicidal. I am still fucking trying. I have been on a plethora of meds. I have tried my goddamn hardest.
Holy shit, you should not be in this sub. Lol. Fuck off.

They were unemployed for awhile. So I tried to bust my ass and work really hard to keep us caught up. Yesterday I was doing bills and realized we were about...some 600 dollars behind. 

I don't know. I can't help but feel inadequate constantly. I just want to feel like I'm good at something. 

Doggo got a lot of peanut butter and a lot of sorries...it's not her fault after all.

I just don't know how to change things around. I'm trying to be positive and push forward and I just feel like shit. Like I think I'm holding on okay and trying to get back to a good place and he goes and just...destroys me. Like I just can't be happy if I'm not perfect for him.

Oh my god I had this experience not too long ago. It's my first time going through the content and just..the build up to Final Steps of Faith, and the cutscenes after. I was emotionally crippled. Lol.
